about: MetalArm's Library: ready-made workouts and programs for each training path. Imported by backend/scripts/import_library.py and checked by app/core/catalog_validator.py. Entries with a legacy_source are the original curated programs and presets, kept so their old endpoints answer exactly as before; they are not shown in the Library. Templates, not coaching.

programs.name: Foundations of Movement
programs.description: Learn to squat, hinge, lunge, push, pull and carry well - three short full-body days a week.

programs.name: Agility & Conditioning
programs.description: Faster feet, a bigger engine and sharper changes of direction, four days a week.

programs.name: Functional Strength Circuits
programs.description: Strength you can use: loaded circuits for the lower body, upper body, whole body and carries.

programs.name: Push / Pull / Legs
programs.description: Each muscle twice a week: push, pull and legs, then again. Take the seventh day off.

programs.name: Upper / Lower
programs.description: Four days, two upper and two lower, built on machines and dumbbells to learn the feel of each muscle.

programs.name: Five-day body-part split
programs.description: One muscle group a day with high volume and effort. For lifters with a few years behind them.

programs.name: Linear Strength Base
programs.description: Two alternating days on the barbell. Add a little weight every session for as long as every set hits its reps.

programs.name: Intermediate Strength Waves
programs.description: One lift a day in three-week waves - fives, triples, singles - each wave a little heavier than the last.

programs.name: Meet Prep Peak
programs.description: Eight weeks to a meet: heavy singles and triples on the competition lifts, lighter the final week.

programs.name: Barbell Foundations
programs.description: Two alternating days of the big barbell lifts. Add weight whenever every set hits its reps.

programs.name: Peak Strength Block
programs.description: Heavy triples on squat, bench and deadlift, with the accessories that move them.

programs.name: Upper / Lower Builder

programs.name: Push Pull Legs

programs.name: Athletic Base
programs.description: Full-body strength, single-leg work and a conditioning finisher - the base everything else is built on.

programs.name: Power and Conditioning
